stem: What happens next in this passage after “In technology class, students discussed recommendation systems.”?
options: At the end of the week, the teacher asked what they had learned.
But every time he heard the wrong name, he felt a little uncomfortable.
They learned that algorithms use patterns, but patterns can be wrong or incomplete.
Students learned to use summaries as entrances, not exits.
